Upgrades

                            
Which StackVend release this install runs, the newest release from the release source, where upgrades come from, and the Update StackVend button (deploys the signed release's services and jobs, never Terraform).

                        

                        
                    


                    


                    
                    

                        
                         — Upgrades come from a repository or key that is not the official StackVend release.
                    


                    
                    

                        

                            
Platform version

                            Mixed versions
                        

                        

                        
Update check off

                        

                            

                                
Services and jobs

ComponentKindReleaseCommitSource

                                
                                    
                                
                            

                        

                        

                            Deploy history
                            
    
                                
                            

                        

                    


                    
                    

                        

                            
Check for updates

                            

                                
                                
                            

                        

                        
On: this Control Center reads the release source repository on GitHub (public data, no sign-in) when you open this tab, at most once an hour. Off: no GitHub call from this tab (forked or network-isolated installs); updates are then manual with the scripts.

                        

                        
                        
                        
                        
                        
                    


                    
                    

                        

                            
Update StackVend

                            Cloud Build ▸ History ↗
                        

                        
Installs the newest release's services and jobs (the same result as deploy-services.sh --all-jobs). It never runs Terraform: a release that changes the platform needs apply.sh from a terminal first. New workload runs are paused (maintenance mode) while it runs; runs already in progress continue.

                        

                        
                        

                        

                        

                            

                            
                            
                        

                        
                        
                        
                        

                            Upgrade history
                            
    
                                
                            

                        

                    


                    
                    

                        
Release source

                        
Where upgrades come from. A change needs a sign-in younger than 15 minutes and typing the repository name; every change is recorded and never trimmed.

                        

                        

                            
                            
                            
                        

                        

                            
Other trusted signing keys (SSH public keys: ed25519 or ecdsa-sha2-nistp256)

                            
                            
                        

                        

                            
                            
                        

                        

                            
                            
                        

                    


                    
                    

                        

                            

                                
Weekly auto-update from upstream

                                
Once a week the platform repository's sync workflow opens a pull request for the newest official release. It never merges. Off by default.

                            

                            
                        

                        

                        
STACKVEND_UPSTREAM_REPO is not set, so the workflow skips every run. Set it with the second command below.

Platform Emergency Stop Kill Switch

                                        
                                    

                                    
High-urgency fail-safe switch to immediately suspend all autonomous agent activities.

                                

                            

                        


                        
                        

                            

                                ⚡ Cloud Workflows
                                
Cancels all in-flight executions of castor-main-orchestrator and castor-sre-remediation.

                            

                            

                                ❄️ Workload Code Freeze
                                
Turns code freeze on and SRE auto-healing off on every workload except decommissioned ones, saving each workload's previous settings so Resume can put them back.

                            

                            

                                🛑 Dispatch Lockout
                                
Rejects all new pull request dispatches, spec decompositions, and background scheduled jobs.

                            

                        


                        
                        

                        
                        

                        
                        

                            

                                
                                
                            


                            

                                

                                    Engaging the kill switch requires confirmation.
                                    Resuming lets new runs start and returns each workload's code freeze and SRE auto-healing to what they were before the stop. A change you made on a workload during the stop is kept. Cancelled runs are not restarted.
